title: C_GenerateKeyPair requires login for session objects
description:
C_GenerateKeyPair returns CKR_USER_NOT_LOGGED_IN for session objects (CKA_TOKEN=false, CKA_PRIVATE=false) when the user is not logged in. Per PKCS#11 spec, session objects with CKA_PRIVATE=false do not require login. SoftHSM2 correctly allows key generation without login for these objects.

Root cause: wp11_pkcs11.c C_GenerateKeyPair line 3869 unconditionally checks !s->logged_in before checking whether the operation needs login (i.e., whether CKA_PRIVATE=true and/or CKA_TOKEN=true).

Impact: pkcs11test Signatures/SignTest.* (18 failures), KeyPairTest.EncryptDecrypt, ReadOnlySessionTest.CreateKeyPairObjects, ReadOnlySessionTest.GenerateKeyInvalid, ReadWriteSessionTest.AsymmetricTokenKeyPair fail.

SoftHSM2 reference: passes all 18 Signatures/SignTest.* tests.

Fix: only enforce login in C_GenerateKeyPair when both CKA_TOKEN=true and CKA_PRIVATE=true in the key templates (i.e., when writing a private key to the persistent keystore). Remove the unconditional !s->logged_in check at line 3869.
